name: Kitten-Roar Pillow
description: A pillow from the condemned quarters. It goes 'mrrrow'. Like a kitten trying to roar. The storm doesn't want it either.

variants.description: The kitten-roar pillow, returned by the Great Sharkstorm with a participation medal pinned through it: NO THANKS. RETURN TO SENDER. TOO STINKY. Mrrrow.

name: Parts Not Included
description: Forks (Jim's), a horseshoe (lucky, allegedly), copper coils, a transformer that hums. For the Build-Your-Own Stenchmaster Entertainment System Kit (ages eight and up).
